# The Orion Nebula: A Cosmic Nursery

Just 1,500 light-years away, the Great Nebula in Orion is a colossal stellar nursery where hot young stars ignite within vast clouds of glowing hydrogen gas, creating the wispy, ethereal structures visible in this deep-space image. This famous stellar birthplace, easily spotted near the three stars of Orion's Belt with just your eyes, spans 40 light-years across and contains hundreds of baby stars shooting jets of material into space at tremendous speeds.
